extraction.notes: No readable official website, church-owned social page, or official summer camp announcement was found for this Nebo provider. No 2027 information was found. A third-party AllEvents listing names 'Solid Rock FWB Church - VBS' for August 2–5, 2026 at 7860 Hwy 226 S., Nebo, NC 28761 (https://allevents.in/nebo/solid-rock-fwb-church-vbs/200030388885414), but an official announcement could not be located, so no card was created. That listing gives event endpoints of 5 p.m. and 8 p.m.; these do not establish daily hours. Address sources also differ: the event listing and a church directory give 7860 NC-226, while a funeral announcement gives 7856 NC-226. Confirm the VBS and venue address directly with the church. Search results for Solid Rock Baptist Church in Berlin, NJ and other similarly named churches are not this provider.
